definitions.explanation: One of the main categories of Japanese honorific language (keigo). Humble language lowers the speaker's own actions to show respect to the listener or the person being discussed. Examples include いたす (humble form of する) and まいる (humble form of 行く/来る).

examples.japanese: 「⟦{申|もう}す→申す：01319_mousu⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{謙譲語|けんじょうご}です。
examples.english: "Mousu" is the humble form of "iu" (to say).

examples.japanese: ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{謙譲語|けんじょうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{正|ただ}しく⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In business, it is important to be able to use humble language correctly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{謙譲語|けんじょうご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{丁寧語|ていねいご}→丁寧語：15824_teineigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese honorific language has three categories: respectful language, humble language, and polite language.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{謙譲|けんじょう}→謙譲：16428_kenjou⟧ (modesty, humility) + ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (language, word).

CULTURAL NOTE:
{謙譲語|けんじょうご} is one of the three main branches of ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧ (honorific language). While ⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧ elevates the actions of others, {謙譲語|けんじょうご} lowers the speaker's own actions to express respect indirectly. Common examples include ⟦いたす→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ for ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, ⟦{参|まい}る→参る：01322_mairu⟧ for ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧/⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧, and ⟦{拝見|はいけん}する→拝見する：01823_haikensuru⟧ for ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謙譲語|けんじょうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use humble language)
- {謙譲語|けんじょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (humble expressions)
- {謙譲語|けんじょうご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧ (humble and respectful language)
